sources.title: Warhounds on Steam
sources.version_boundary: English Steam listing observed after the August 11, 2026 release

claims.statement: The base supports recruiting soldiers, upgrading them, and purchasing equipment.
The player manages logistics, finances, medical care, and downtime from the base.
The strategic layer includes working with allied factions and managing relationships.
Intelligence and covert operations are explicitly named parts of the command layer.
Campaign decisions can alter missions, equipment access, and which allies provide support.

unknowns: The checked sources do not publish the complete facility tree, costs, prerequisites, or a universal optimal upgrade order.
The guide labels its priority ladder as a planning framework derived from confirmed systems.
Patch-sensitive balance and economy values require current-build verification before publication as facts.
